objective: Test a genuinely two-parent, topology-neutral path-relinking/crossover operator on all 22 independently audited catalog-derived E=2 starts, arranged as 11 deterministic complement-normalized pairs and run in both directions, with an immediate portfolio stop and full certification if E=0 is found.

hypothesis.repair: At least 20 of the 22 directional path-relink children will repair to E<=2 within 10000 selected single-edge repair moves.
hypothesis.strict_plateau_departure: At least one of the 22 verified finals will have E<=1, or will have E=2 with mixed conflict colors or conflict-pair vertex overlap at most 3.
hypothesis.interpretation: Failure or success is a bounded computational observation. Only a fully audited E=0 output is a certified construction; no nonzero portfolio outcome is evidence of nonexistence.

input_provenance.pool_choice: Use the 22 audited E=2 starts as parents because their complement-normalized local-alignment distances range from 0 to 300. The 22 retained conflict-block finals are not used as distinct parents because the final-pool audit found local-alignment distance 0 for all 231 pairs, i.e. a single isomorphism/complement class.
input_provenance.known_topology_before_registration: All 22 starts and all 22 conflict-block finals have two same-color conflicts whose vertex sets overlap in exactly four vertices. This diagnostic is recorded but is not used by child generation, move scoring, repair, or retention.

pairing.policy: Complement precisely the original I5-only member of every pair, retain the original C5-only member, locally align by the deterministic audit mapping, and execute A-to-B then B-to-A. Pairs are selected deterministically by the frozen audit, require opposite original color sides, and cover each of the 22 starts exactly once.
pairing.zero_alignment_explanation: For the one isomorphic aligned pair, ignore the zero-distance isomorphism and use the deterministic identity embedding, whose oriented labeled disagreement is 442, so the registered crossover is nondegenerate.

strategy.child_generation: Starting from the directional source parent, make exactly 48 moves along the aligned parent-disagreement path. At each path step sample 24 remaining target edges without replacement and choose an edge with minimum exact full-objective delta, with deterministic seeded tie-breaking.
strategy.repair: Run exact incremental single-edge min-conflicts from the retained child with tabu tenure 11, 3 percent random walk, breakout interval 250, agreement-break penalty 4, corridor penalty 1, and complete objective audits every 250 selected moves.
strategy.genuine_two_parent_boundary: Child generation requires two separately audited parent graphs, a frozen vertex alignment, a directional disagreement set, and a 48-edge partial path toward the target. It is not a single-trajectory conflict-block mutation.
strategy.topology_neutrality: Conflict colors and overlap topology are never consulted by the search executable. Every strict objective improvement is retained; E=0 is written immediately. Topology is computed only afterward by the independent structural verifier.
strategy.coverage: Process the 22 registered jobs in deterministic pair and direction order. Stop the active job and launch no later job only after a triple-verified E=0 output; otherwise execute every registered job.

disk_reserve_gate: Immediately before launching any production job, require free bytes to be at least storage_limit_bytes plus disk_reserve_bytes_after_registered_cap, i.e. 220000000 bytes. Recheck after every verified job and abort if free space falls below the 200000000-byte reserve.

every_retained_final: Direct Python enumeration of every five-set and all ten pairs
Separately compiled C++ recursive-bitset graph/complement verifier
Independent complement, alignment, parent, child, path-depth, trace, graph6, distance, topology, and budget audit
E_equals_0_only: Write the graph immediately and stop the active and all later registered searches
Require both direct graph verifiers and the independent structural audit
Run parser-path, relabel, complement, and repeat C++ adversarial audit

metrics: E0, E1, and E2 counts over completed registered jobs
repair-to-E<=2 count and preregistered hypothesis outcome
E2 mixed-color, overlap-at-most-3, and same-color-overlap-4 counts
distance from each aligned parent after repair
exact selected repair moves, delta evaluations, runtime, and artifact bytes

outcome_policy.valid_E0: Label CERTIFIED only after both direct graph verifiers, the independent path/crossover audit, canonical export, and adversarial audit all pass.
outcome_policy.nonzero_best: Label REPRODUCIBLE COMPUTATIONAL OBSERVATION, report every registered run and every preregistered metric, and make no construction or nonexistence claim.
outcome_policy.timeout_or_error: Record the bounded failure and exact coverage, and make no construction or nonexistence claim.
